headline: Proposed 179-apartment building at 37 Enon Street, and traffic safety reviews at Peabody, Larcom and Sargent avenues.
summary: The meeting opens with a public comment period of up to 15 minutes. It also covers a council request to review Essex and Cole streets, where eight areas will be prioritized, and a pedestrian safety concern at Hale and Corning streets.
items: Public comment period, up to 15 minutes

Recommendation to Planning Board on site plan review (SPR 26-42) and special permit (SP-26-5) for 37 Enon Street: 179 apartments, about 2,600 sf of retail space, 281 parking spaces where 367 are required, and 1.5 parking spaces per unit; continued from previous meeting
Traffic and pedestrian safety concerns at the Peabody Avenue, Larcom Avenue and Sargent Avenue intersection, with possible recommendations; continued from previous meeting
Pedestrian safety concerns at the Hale Street and Corning Street intersection, with possible recommendation
Recommendation to City Council on Order #258-2026, a request to review Essex Street and Cole Street; prioritize eight areas for further review
Construction update for 119 Rantoul Street (standing item, no update given)
location: 1st Floor Conference Room, Temporary Beverly City Hall, 175 Cabot Street, Beverly, MA
